text:
You’re rarely going to get the absolute best outcome from any idea.
People get so fixated on being perfect or the best outcome that they turn a good outcome into a bad one.

Just keep recycling good ideas and dont fall in love with them. Original ideas are cheaper and beat chasing advanced ideas.

Play them well, capture a solid portion of the move, and be content to walk away.

Work with fewer ideas and focus on the ones you actually have conviction in.
